sources.title: Republic of Nauru Government Gazette No. 7 of 2026, G.N. No. 28/2026 (Public Service Act 2016, s. 81)
sources.said: PURSUANT TO the powers in that behalf vested in me under Section 81, subsection 1,2 & 3 of the Public Service Act 2016, the following days shall be observed by officers and employees of the Public Service as Public Holidays for the year 2026. Thursday 1st January, 2026 New Year’s Day Saturday 31st January, 2026 Independence Day Sunday 1st February, 2026 Day following Independence Day Sunday 8th March, 2026 International Women’s Day Friday 3rd April, 2026 Good Friday Monday 6th April, 2026 Easter Monday Tuesday 7th April, 2026 Easter Tuesday Sunday 17th May, 2026 Constitution Day Friday 26th June, 2026 Eigigu Day Monday 29th June, 2026 Remembrance Day Wednesday 1st July, 2026 RONPHOS Handover Saturday 25th July, 2026 International Day for Judicial Well-Being Wednesday 19th August, 2026 Ibumin Earoeni Day Friday 25th September, 2026 Sir Hammer DeRoburt Day Monday 26th October, 2026 Angam Day Friday 25th December, 2026 Christmas Day Saturday 26th December, 2026 Day following Christmas Whenever a day specified in subsection (1) except Independence Day and Christmas Day, falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the following Monday is a holiday. Whenever Independence Day and Christmas Day, falls on Saturday or a Sunday the following Monday and Tuesday are holidays.
